summary: Iteration 3 validates (A) Partnerships & Alliances strip on Home and (B) Admin-uploadable Capability Statement PDF with auto-refresh of NAICS + Federal Registration. Also confirms the Admin.jsx JSX guard fix (post-editor modal wrapped in {editing && (}) — /admin now renders without crash. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (added test_capability.py: GET /api/capability returns 19 NAICS w/ code+desc, 6 registration entries, >=25 agencies, pdf=/assets/Lotus-USA-Capability-Statement.pdf; POST /api/capability/upload unauth -> 401; admin upload of the sample PDF -> ok=true, extracted.naics==19, follow-up GET returns UEI=JBKGG25MLPM9, CAGE=771V6, DUNS=079599348, Federal Tax ID=47-1943686; non-PDF upload -> 400). Existing suite unchanged: auth, contacts + Emergent email proxy 202, newsletter (dedupe), blog CRUD. Frontend (Playwright): Home partnerships strip shows all 3 text cards (Cisco Systems/Select Partner, Oracle/Oracle Partner Network (OPN), SAP/Certified Consultants) via data-testid=partnerships. About NAICS section shows 19 codes by default and filters to exactly 1 when searching '541512'. Home + Contact both show UEI JBKGG25MLPM9. All 3 download-capability buttons (home/about/contact) point to /assets/Lotus-USA-Capability-Statement.pdf. Admin login works via get_by_role('Sign In'); dashboard renders with stat cards (Total Leads, Subscribers, Published, Drafts) and all 4 tabs (Leads/Subscribers/Blog/Capability); role=dialog count on mount = 0 (guard fix verified — post-editor modal no longer renders on admin load). Capability tab renders NAICS chips (541512, 541513, 541611 ... 621512 — 19 items), Federal Registration card with UEI JBKGG25MLPM9, CAGE 771V6, DUNS 079599348, Federal Tax ID 47-1943686, SAM Active/Registered, CMMC Level 2. Backend-side upload works (validated via pytest); front-end file-chooser upload via set_input_files on the hidden input was flaky in the automation harness (timeout on locator visibility) but this is a test-harness limitation, not a product bug — the real user path goes through the visible 'Upload PDF' button which triggers the hidden input via ref/label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py parse_capability_pdf regex tolerates common variants (UEI/UNIQUE ENTITY ID/IDENTIFIER, CAGE with/without CODE, TAX ID variants) — good; also falls back to DEFAULT_REGISTRATION when a value is not found, avoiding data loss.

capability collection is keyed by literal _id='current' (upsert). Works well as singleton but be aware Mongo will store this as a string _id (not ObjectId) — get_capability_doc handles this correctly and pop's _id before returning.
PDF is saved to /app/frontend/public/assets which requires the CRA dev server to be running to serve it back; in production this must be handled by the static/CDN layer.
server.py is ~520 lines — approaching split threshold. Consider extracting capability, auth, blog routers into modules when adding more features.
Admin.jsx uploadCapability handler correctly refreshes context and shows toast with parsed.naics count — matches spec.
Post-editor modal guard {editing && (...)} confirmed present (no dialog rendered on mount).
seed_data_creation: TEST_John Doe contact (deleted at end of run) + TEST_EmailProbe contact (leftover — visible as 1 lead on admin). Newsletter TEST_ email created (idempotent). No capability seed changes beyond the current->current upsert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Capability tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_capability.py. Frontend data-testids: partnerships, naics-section/naics-search-input/naics-results/naics-empty, download-capability-home/about/contact, admin-tab-leads/subscribers/blog/capability, capability-upload-input (hidden file input — use set_input_files on the selector directly; browser automation may need retry). The capability upload endpoint is idempotent (write-then-parse); safe to re-run. Admin login button: get_by_role('button', name='Sign In').
rca of the issue: N/A — the previously reported broken {editing && (} JSX guard was already fixed by main agent before this iteration. Verified: /admin loads and role=dialog count is 0 on mount; the post-editor modal only opens after clicking New Post/Edit.
